notes: GLiFormer Large v1 NER LiteRT (litert-community/GLiFormer-Large-NER-LiteRT, published 2026-09-26, Hub revision dee6ced): the entity-extraction path of knowledgator/gliformer-large-v1 (rev d0a4e53d; DeBERTa-large 24-layer encoder + word BiLSTM + span scorer, 5 labels), head graph of the s512 split window (text / parent / label routing matmuls, the word BiLSTM unrolled for T=512 words, anchor fusion and the span scorer): inputs encoder_hidden [1,1,512,1024] / text_routing [1,512,512] / parent_routing [1,1,512] / label_routing [1,5,512] / text_mask [1,512] float32, output output_0 [1,1,512,15]. It runs on the CPU on Android: unrolled BiLSTM heads of this size crash CompiledModel creation on the S26 GPU (SIGSEGV in the OpenCL driver once one sequential chain passes about 85 steps, LiteRT issue 10300 with the round-12 reproducers), so no GPU row exists for this file. wfp16 storage: 9 float16 weight tensors read through a DEQUANTIZE to float32, everything else float32 (25,112 operators vs 25,103 in the fp32 reference). GpuOptions(precision = FP32) is the validated Android setting; with GpuOptions omitted (the runtime's default GPU precision) the s128 wfp16 graph compiled and returned finite logits but 0/10 entity span sets (recorded in the s128 wfp16 file). artifact_sha256 = the on-device sha256 of the pushed file (the run directory's *_hash_*.stdout.log), equal to the Hub LFS sha256 (resolve URL x-linked-etag, read 2026-09-26), public/manifest.json and the local public/ copy. Every number read programmatically from the lane's JSONs / raw outputs (build script kept in the session scratchpad); peak_mem_mb = the process VmHWM in bytes / 1e6 (the bytes are in metrics); model-level facts only, no op row derives from these records.
